entries.question: Opd registration online
entries.answer:
To register for a KGMU OPD appointment online, please follow these steps:

**Booking Methods:**
*   **Online Registration System (ORS):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select "Uttar Pradesh" as the state and "KGMU" as the hospital. Follow the prompts to select your department, date, and time, then complete the payment of ₹50 to download your slip.
*   **ABHA/Health Care App:** You can register using your mobile number and OTP through the official government health applications, following the same hospital selection flow.
*   **SMS:** You may send an SMS with the text `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.

**Important Information:**
*   **Fee:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50 for all booking methods.
*   **Registration:** Online registration is mandatory.
*   **Timings:** OPD clinics operate Monday–Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). They are closed on Sundays.
*   **Important Note:** If you are visiting from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid referral for the specific department. Pre-booking is strongly recommended to minimize wait times, as the ticket counters close at 1:00 PM sharp.

For any further assistance, you may contact the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: how can a patient in other hospital other than kgmu get human milk from human milk bank kgmu lko
entries.answer:
Patients from other hospitals can access donor human milk from the KGMU Human Milk Bank by following these steps:

1.  **Medical Referral:** The patient's treating physician or the hospital where the infant is admitted must provide a formal medical referral letter. This letter should clearly state the medical necessity for donor human milk for the infant.
2.  **Contact the Department:** You should contact the Department of Pediatrics at KGMU, which oversees the Human Milk Bank. You may reach out via the KGMU main helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333** to be directed to the appropriate coordinator for the Milk Bank.
3.  **Process:** Upon presenting the medical referral, the KGMU medical team will assess the request based on the availability of donor milk and the specific clinical needs of the infant. 
4.  **Important Note:** Donor human milk is primarily prioritized for preterm or sick infants admitted within KGMU. Supplies provided to outside hospitals are subject to current availability and institutional protocols.

For further inquiries, you may visit the Department of Pediatrics at KGMU or check the [Department of Pediatrics page](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=6&dept_type=2) for specific contact information.

entries.question: Process for mbbs admission after annoucement of up neet round 1 result

2.  **Download Allotment Letter:** If allotted a seat at KGMU, download your official allotment letter from the portal.
3.  **Document Verification:** You must report to the designated Nodal Center or the KGMU campus (as specified in your allotment letter) for document verification. Ensure you carry the original documents and multiple sets of photocopies.
4.  **Fee Payment:** Pay the required admission/tuition fee as prescribed by the university. Payment is typically handled through the online portal or as directed by the allotment instructions.
5.  **Final Reporting:** After successful verification and fee payment, report to the KGMU admission office/concerned department to complete the final enrollment formalities and receive your joining letter.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Deadlines:** Strictly adhere to the reporting dates mentioned in your allotment letter. Failure to report within the stipulated time will result in the cancellation of your seat.
*   **Official Updates:** For specific instructions regarding KGMU, please monitor the [KGMU Admissions page](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) and the [UP NEET official website](https://upneet.gov.in/).
*   **Queries:** If you face issues with the online process or specific document requirements, contact the KGMU Registrar office at **0522-2253171**.

Please avoid sharing personal data (such as your NEET roll number, rank, or contact details) in this chat for your safety. Always rely on the official DGME UP NEET website for counseling steps.

2. **Expectations:** Ho sakta hai ki wahan ke staff aapko kahein ki "abhi admission brochure nahi aaya hai, aap website check karti rahiye." Aisa isliye hota hai kyunki har saal thode bahut niyam ya fees badal sakte hain.
3. **Taiyari:** Aapka abhi se jaankari lena ek bahut achha kadam hai. Entrance exam ki taiyari ke liye aap KGMU ki website ka "Notice Board" section aur "Academic" section samay-samay par check karti rahein, wahan pichhle saal ke admission notices honge jisse aapko ek idea mil jayega ki pichhle saal kya fees thi.

Aap bilkul bejhijhak call karke pooch sakti hain. All the best aapki taiyari ke liye!

Main samajh sakta hoon ki aapko website par sahi jaankari dhundhne mein pareshani ho rahi hai. KGMU ki website kaafi badi hai, isliye wahan har cheez dhundhna thoda mushkil ho sakta hai.

GNM course ki jaankari aur fees dekhne ke liye aap ye steps follow karein:

1. **Website par Courses ka Section:**
   * Jab aap [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) kholti hain, toh menu mein **"Academic"** ya **"Courses & Admission"** ka ek tab hoga.
   * Agar wahan seedhe list nahi dikh rahi hai, toh aap website ke **"Notice Board"** ([https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php)) par jayein. Wahan par "Admission Notice" ya "Prospectus" naam ki PDFs hoti hain. 

2. **Sabse aasaan tareeka (KGMU Search ka upyog):**
   * Kyunki website par menu dhundhna mushkil hai, aap KGMU par ye type karke search karein: **"KGMU GNM Admission Prospectus PDF"**. 
   * Isse aapko seedhe pichhle saal ke admission ki PDF mil jayegi. Us PDF mein "Fee Structure" aur "Hostel" ka ek alag page hota hai.

3. **Nursing College ki alag website:**
   * KGMU ke andar **"College of Nursing"** hota hai. Aap KGMU par **"KGMU College of Nursing Lucknow"** search karein. Aksar nursing courses ki saari jaankari unke alag portal par hoti hai.

**Ek zaroori sujhav:**
KGMU mein GNM course ki seats aur fees har saal thodi badal sakti hain. Agar aapko website par "Modi ji ki photo" ya sirf general images dikh rahi hain, toh iska matlab hai ki aap **"Home Page"** par hain. Aapko website ke upar ya side mein bane **"Academic"** ya **"Admission"** likhe hue button par click karna hoga.

**Aapke liye abhi kya sahi hai?**
Agar aap 2027 mein exam dena chahti hain, toh aap abhi se fees aur hostel ki chinta chhodkar **"KGMU Nursing Entrance Syllabus"** search karein aur apni padhai shuru karein. Fees ka structure admission ke time par nikle notification mein hi sabse sahi hota hai.

Agar aapko website bilkul samajh nahi aa rahi, toh aap **PRO (Public Relations Officer) Office** ke number [0522-2258880](tel:05222258880) par call karke sirf itna puchein: *"Kya aap mujhe nursing admission ka brochure email kar sakte hain?"* Wo aapko sahi PDF bhej denge.
